gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.
'Her persistence' — the quality noun from persistent.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: Much to everyone’s ___ (APPOINT), the open-air concert was cancelled.
gaps.explanation: 'To somebody’s disappointment' — the feeling noun follows the possessive.
